next_probe_tests.test: Read selected primary works on construct validity, treatment-version consistency, causal estimands, and social-kind constitution. Map whether each already distinguishes package effects from kind-specific interpretation when an intervention changes constitutive relations.
next_probe_tests.decision_rule: If an existing account fully captures the distinction, remove any novelty claim and decide whether the example still makes a useful application; otherwise specify the exact residual gap.

next_probe_tests.test: Formalize a minimal randomized case where K(0) and K(1) may differ. Separate the package effect, the effect on category status, and any claim about the population whose practice remains K under both assignments.
next_probe_tests.decision_rule: State which estimands randomization identifies and what additional assumptions would be required; do not infer a same-K effect from the package contrast alone.

next_probe_tests.test: Apply the predeclared target rule to outcomes both favorable and unfavorable to the theory, including a case where category status changes after intervention.
next_probe_tests.decision_rule: If the rule can be changed after seeing outcomes without independent evidence, reject it as protective redescription.

next_probe_tests.test: Find a case where a practice's recognition or reciprocity changes under treatment but a well-supported account says that change is irrelevant to the target kind.
next_probe_tests.decision_rule: Use the case to narrow the range of claims requiring the proposed target-link warrant.
